strengths: RECHECKED b1-ch23-fight-r1-editor-001: resolved. The repaired draft consistently presents the planted-stance/back-leg/rib-to-hip route as Cael's explicit in-POV hypothesis and model, with the ruling limited to this one observed bout; no narrator-voice assertion of universal Iron Path physics survives.
The four-exchange structure is exceptionally legible: measurement, accumulation, adversary adaptation, then committed escalation and a narrow finish.
The victory has receipts. Lira's precision-over-power drilling and Feryn's psychological scouting visibly govern Cael's choices rather than serving as retrospective explanation.
The concurrence is handled with the required boundary discipline: involuntary first arrival, partial mitigation, real cost, no new fragment, and no claim of repeatability or understanding.

Darrow remains a credible professional through defeat. He adapts during the bout, falls by depletion rather than humiliation, rises under his own power, and pays respect without acquiring Cael's voice.

The visibility strategy pays off through concrete social behavior—greetings, retellings, touch, and people who would ask questions—while the prose correctly refuses to claim that the Compact threat itself has changed.
The final notebook sequence preserves uncertainty and lands the exact required line without appending an explanatory coda.
